My dear [Bella](/person/1690)
I think the day had better be Friday, as [Gertrude](/person/1462) has been rather out of order these last few days, but is picking up again.

It will be a great day of church decoration, but I shall be sure to have done by 4 o’clock, and I shall be very glad to see you and [Miss Fawcett](/person/2395).[^1]

Yours affectionately

C M Yonge


[^1]: The feast day of St Matthew, patron of Otterbourne Church, is 21 September, which fell on a Saturday in 1889.
